criteria.criterion: After the tag and the release, publish retries `go list -m github.com/mvelosop/vloop@<version>` every 30 seconds until it succeeds, up to --wait (default 10m), else refuses `release: the module proxy does not serve <version> after <wait>` (exit 1).
criteria.evidence: publish.go waitProxy with proxyInterval 30s, wait default 10m, fail message; test asserts exact stderr and exit 1

criteria.criterion: Then `go install github.com/mvelosop/vloop/cmd/vloop@<version>` into a temporary GOBIN (never inside the repository), whose `vloop version --json` must report the version (without v) and the module (<version>); otherwise `release: go install …@<version> reports version <v>, module <m>` (exit 1).
criteria.evidence: installCheck uses MkdirTemp GOBIN; mismatch check in publish; test asserts message and GOBIN outside repo

criteria.criterion: Each step already done prints `<step>: already done` (`tag: already done`, `release: already done`) and is skipped; a fully done release re-runs only the public-install check and ends with the four success lines, exit 0.
criteria.evidence: already-done branches print; test loops two full re-runs, exit 0, release created once

criteria.criterion: `publish <version> --dry-run` makes the checks it can without writing — no tag, push or release — and prints each step.
criteria.evidence: dryRun branches print would-lines and return 0 before proxy/install; test checks no tag on origin and no release create

criteria.criterion: The tool's tests use stubs for gh, go and claude on PATH and a local bare repository as origin, in temporary directories with a temporary HOME, addressed with git -C; no test runs the real gh, go install from the network, or this repository's origin.
criteria.evidence: publish_test.go goStub and gh stubs in STUBS dir on PATH, prepared() local origin

criteria.criterion: Committed tests, run by the checks, cover the proxy wait and its refusal (with a short --wait), the version mismatch, the temporary GOBIN, the already-done re-runs and --dry-run.
criteria.evidence: TestPublishProxyAndRerun covers each; go check exit 0
